# [Implementation] - Task Plan

## 1. Context

- Smoke section extracted from the archived #320 plan at #364; the body is omitted.

### Manual Smoke Test Protocol

All sandboxes live under `$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-320*` — the only path the storage guard
positively recognises as the tool's own sandbox. `env -u AGY_SUBAGENT` keeps the root-mutation
guard from refusing the state-mutating commands. Each block is self-contained: run it from the
worktree root (`ROOT="$PWD"`), and it builds the worktree's own `dist/` first.

**Check 1 — Defect A: an implementation plan can no longer release the RCA gate (AC1, AC2)**

```bash
ROOT="$PWD"
npm run build
SMOKE="$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-320-gate"
rm -rf "$SMOKE" && mkdir -p "$SMOKE" && cd "$SMOKE"
env -u AGY_SUBAGENT node "$ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" transition DISCOVERY --issue 3201 --title "probe"
PLAN_DIR="$(ls -d "$(pwd)"/artifacts/plans/3201-* 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)"
test -n "$PLAN_DIR" || { echo 'FAIL: transition did not scaffold a plan directory'; exit 1; }
cat > "$PLAN_DIR/implementation_plan.md" <<'EOF'
# [Implementation] - probe

## 1. Context & Objectives
- **Feature Overview:** substantive implementation content that must never satisfy the RCA gate.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** the RCA gate holds at DISCOVERY.

## 2. Architectural Design & Impact
- **Component Breakdown:** the gate and the directive.
- **Data Flow / Model Invariants:** kind is checked before content.
- **Dependencies & Imports:** domain predicates only.

## 3. Implementation Steps
- [ ] **Step 1:** add the discovery-shape filter before DiscoveryReport scoring.

## 4. Quality Gate & Test Verification
- **Target 1:** npm run lint
EOF
OUT="$(env -u AGY_SUBAGENT node "$ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" plan --issue 3201 --title "feature probe" 2>&1)"
printf '%s\n' "$OUT"
printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | grep -q 'Parked at DISCOVERY' || { echo 'FAIL: expected a DISCOVERY park'; exit 1; }
printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | grep -q '\[Discovery\] - probe\.md' || { echo 'FAIL: park must name the blank discovery report'; exit 1; }
printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | grep -q 'Missing evidence' || { echo 'FAIL: park must name the missing evidence'; exit 1; }
if printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | grep -q 'Pipeline advanced to \[PLAN\]'; then echo 'FAIL: implementation plan released the RCA gate'; exit 1; fi
grep -q '"currentStage": "DISCOVERY"' .agyloop/tasks/3201.json || { echo 'FAIL: checkpoint advanced'; exit 1; }
echo 'PASS: gate holds and names the RCA report'
cd /; rm -rf "$SMOKE"
```

**Check 2 — Defect A's second door: no discovery artifact, implementation plan present (AC1, AC6)**

```bash
ROOT="$PWD"
npm run build
SMOKE="$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-320-nodiscovery"
rm -rf "$SMOKE" && mkdir -p "$SMOKE" && cd "$SMOKE"
env -u AGY_SUBAGENT node "$ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" transition DISCOVERY --issue 3202 --title "probe"
PLAN_DIR="$(ls -d "$(pwd)"/artifacts/plans/3202-* 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)"
test -n "$PLAN_DIR" || { echo 'FAIL: transition did not scaffold a plan directory'; exit 1; }
rm -f "$PLAN_DIR/[Discovery] - probe.md"
cat > "$PLAN_DIR/implementation_plan.md" <<'EOF'
# [Implementation] - probe

## 1. Context & Objectives
- **Feature Overview:** stale substantive plan from a previous run.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** it must not be RCA evidence.

## 2. Architectural Design & Impact
- **Component Breakdown:** resolver fallback.
- **Data Flow / Model Invariants:** DISCOVERY resolution never returns an implementation document.
- **Dependencies & Imports:** none.

## 3. Implementation Steps
- [ ] **Step 1:** remove the implementation-alias fallback at DISCOVERY.

## 4. Quality Gate & Test Verification
- **Target 1:** node --test tests/generator.test.ts
EOF
OUT="$(env -u AGY_SUBAGENT node "$ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" plan --issue 3202 --title "feature probe" 2>&1)"
printf '%s\n' "$OUT"
printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | grep -q 'Parked at DISCOVERY' || { echo 'FAIL: expected a DISCOVERY park with no discovery artifact'; exit 1; }
if printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | grep -q 'Pipeline advanced to \[PLAN\]'; then echo 'FAIL: the resolver fallback released the RCA gate'; exit 1; fi
grep -q '"currentStage": "DISCOVERY"' .agyloop/tasks/3202.json || { echo 'FAIL: checkpoint advanced'; exit 1; }
echo 'PASS: no discovery artifact means no RCA evidence'
cd /; rm -rf "$SMOKE"
```

**Check 3 — Reopened issue (`COMPLETED → DISCOVERY`) with a stale substantive plan (AC3)**

```bash
ROOT="$PWD"
npm run build
SMOKE="$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-320-reentry"
rm -rf "$SMOKE" && mkdir -p "$SMOKE/artifacts/plans/3203-probe" "$SMOKE/.agyloop/tasks" && cd "$SMOKE"
PLAN_DIR="$(pwd)/artifacts/plans/3203-probe"
cat > "$PLAN_DIR/[Discovery] - probe.md" <<'EOF'
# [Discovery] - probe

## 1. Problem Statement & Symptoms
- **Observed Behavior:**
- **Expected Behavior:**
EOF
cat > "$PLAN_DIR/implementation_plan.md" <<'EOF'
# [Implementation] - probe

## 1. Context & Objectives
- **Feature Overview:** the previous completed run's substantive plan.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** it stays parked after the reopen.

## 2. Architectural Design & Impact
- **Component Breakdown:** re-entry gate and the directive.
- **Data Flow / Model Invariants:** kind is checked before content.
- **Dependencies & Imports:** domain predicates only.

## 3. Implementation Steps
- [ ] **Step 1:** park instead of advancing.

## 4. Quality Gate & Test Verification
- **Target 1:** npm run lint
EOF
NOW="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
cat > .agyloop/tasks/3203.json <<EOF
{
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "currentStage": "COMPLETED",
  "mode": "standard",
  "issue": 3203,
  "planDir": "$PLAN_DIR",
  "baseBranch": "main",
  "createdAt": "$NOW",
  "updatedAt": "$NOW",
  "history": [{ "stage": "COMPLETED", "timestamp": "$NOW" }]
}
EOF
env -u AGY_SUBAGENT node "$ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" transition DISCOVERY --issue 3203 >/dev/null
OUT="$(env -u AGY_SUBAGENT node "$ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" plan --issue 3203 --title "feature probe" 2>&1)"
printf '%s\n' "$OUT"
printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | grep -q 'Parked at DISCOVERY' || { echo 'FAIL: reopened issue bypassed the RCA gate'; exit 1; }
printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | grep -q '\[Discovery\] - probe\.md' || { echo 'FAIL: park must name the blank discovery report'; exit 1; }
grep -q '"currentStage": "DISCOVERY"' .agyloop/tasks/3203.json || { echo 'FAIL: checkpoint advanced from DISCOVERY'; exit 1; }
echo 'PASS: reopened issue parks at DISCOVERY'
cd /; rm -rf "$SMOKE"
```

**Check 4 — Defect B: the directive reports the report state (AC4, AC5, AC7)**

```bash
ROOT="$PWD"
npm run build
SMOKE="$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-320-directive"
rm -rf "$SMOKE" && mkdir -p "$SMOKE" && cd "$SMOKE"
env -u AGY_SUBAGENT node "$ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" transition DISCOVERY --issue 3204 --title "probe" >/dev/null
node "$ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" next --issue 3204 --json > read1.json
grep -q '"discoveryReportPopulated": false' read1.json || { echo 'FAIL read1: populated must be false'; exit 1; }
grep -q 'still blank' read1.json || { echo 'FAIL read1: the blank state is not named'; exit 1; }
grep -q 'Missing evidence' read1.json || { echo 'FAIL read1: missing evidence is not named'; exit 1; }
REPORT="$(grep -o '"discoveryReportPath": "[^"]*"' read1.json | sed 's/.*": "//; s/"$//')"
test -n "$REPORT" || { echo 'FAIL read1: no discoveryReportPath'; exit 1; }
cat > "$REPORT" <<'EOF'
# [Discovery] - probe

## 1. Problem Statement & Symptoms
- **Observed Behavior:** next never reported the RCA state
- **Expected Behavior:** the directive reports populated/blank
- **Affected Components / Paths:** src/application/get-next-action.ts

## 2. Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
- **Investigation Steps:** read the directive twice around a report write
- **Identified Failure Mode:** a static condition constant rendered as state
- **Relevant Code References:** get-next-action.ts:373-465

## 3. Reproduction Steps & Verification Protocol
- **Local Reproduction Command:** codeloop next --issue 3204 --json
- **Failing Test Target:** tests/application/get-next-action.test.ts

## 4. Remediation Strategy
- **Recommended Fix Approach:** project DiscoveryReport state into the result
- **Potential Regressions / Side Effects:** none when no generator is injected
EOF
node "$ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" next --issue 3204 --json > read2.json
grep -q '"discoveryReportPopulated": true' read2.json || { echo 'FAIL read2: populated must be true'; exit 1; }
grep -q 'completion condition is met' read2.json || { echo 'FAIL read2: the met condition is not named'; exit 1; }
grep -q 'codeloop plan --issue 3204' read2.json || { echo 'FAIL read2: the advance command is missing'; exit 1; }
if grep -q 'still blank' read2.json; then echo 'FAIL read2: the populated report is still called blank'; exit 1; fi
grep -q '"currentStage": "DISCOVERY"' .agyloop/tasks/3204.json || { echo 'FAIL: next advanced the stage'; exit 1; }
env -u AGY_SUBAGENT node "$ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" plan --issue 3204 >/dev/null 2>&1
grep -q '"currentStage": "PLAN"' .agyloop/tasks/3204.json || { echo 'FAIL: the directive was not truthful — plan did not advance'; exit 1; }
echo 'PASS: directive reports blank then populated, and next never advances'
cd /; rm -rf "$SMOKE"
```
